While their operational influence had already diminished, their departure is seen as a psychological setback, with the BJP likely to leverage the defections to portray AAP as a 'sinking ship'.
title: Sinking ship? AAP’s 2022 strategists who cracked 'Punjab code' out ahead of crucial 2027 battle

author: NITIN NAIK
description: ​It was a balmy Friday in Mumbai, and the CK Nayudu Hall at the Brabourne Stadium got warmer with emotion as members of the Legends Club congregated to celebrate Sachin Tendulkar’s 53rd birthday.
title: When Harbhajan and Zaheer threw Sachin Tendulkar into a Jacuzzi

author: MALLICA JOSHI AND AMBIKA PANDIT
title: AAP expected Raghav Chadha, Swati Maliwal exits; why Sandeep Pathak’s departure hits party the most

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Israel and Lebanon have extended a three-week ceasefire, with Prime Minister Netanyahu aiming for "historic peace" and crediting US pressure on Iran. Despite the truce, Hezbollah dismisses it as "meaningless" amid ongoing Israeli military actions and retaliatory clashes.  This fragile calm persists amidst wider regional tensions, leaving lasting agreement prospects uncertain.
title: Netanyahu accuses Hezbollah of 'sabotaging' Lebanon peace push

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: An IRS officer's daughter was brutally murdered by a former domestic help, Rahu, who exhibited psychopathic tendencies and a history of aggression. Investigations reveal his addiction to online betting led to significant financial losses, driving the crime. Rahul used his knowledge of the victim's home to gain entry, commit the heinous act, and attempt to steal cash.
title: Delhi IRS officer daughter’s rape-murder: Accused addicted to online games, had violent past

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Fans' long-held dream of seeing Bollywood's three Khans – Shah Rukh, Salman, and Aamir – together on screen might be closer than ever. Aamir Khan recently expressed his strong desire to collaborate with Shah Rukh, revealing they've discussed it but await the perfect story.
title: Aamir Khan shares admiration for SRK; keen to work on film with him and Salman Khan

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Justice Department has closed its investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell regarding headquarters renovation cost overruns. This move removes a hurdle for Kevin Warsh's confirmation as Fed chair. The probe's closure allows scrutiny to continue through the Inspector General's office, with potential for criminal investigation restart if warranted.
title: US justice dept closes criminal investigation into Fed chief Jerome Powell

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: The Enforcement Directorate conducted searches at multiple locations in West Bengal on Saturday as part of its money laundering investigation into the alleged ration distribution scam. Raids included the residence of businessman Partha Sarathi in North 24 Parganas, aiming to gather evidence on financial transactions and fund diversion related to the PDS scam.
title: ED conducts raids in Kolkata, North 24 Parganas in ration scam probe

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Deloitte plans to reduce paid family leave from 16 to eight weeks and cut annual paid time off by 5-10 days for a segment of its US workforce starting January 1, 2027. These changes, affecting internal roles under the 'Center' talent model, aim to tailor benefits to market alignment. New pension plan contributions and adoption/surrogacy reimbursements will also cease.
title: Starting January 1, Deloitte cuts parental leave, PTO, pension, IVF funding in US

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The US has tightened its grip on Iran's oil revenue by sanctioning a major Chinese refinery and numerous shipping entities involved in transporting Iranian crude. This move targets a "shadow network" and escalates pressure amid regional tensions. China has criticized the sanctions, urging an end to their political use and warning of harm to legitimate trade.
title: US sanctions China's 'teapot' refinery & 40 shipping companies over Iran oil trade

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft is offering voluntary retirement to approximately 7% of its US workforce, marking its first such program in 51 years. This softer approach, unlike previous layoffs, aims to manage costs and reputation amid stock price pressure and AI infrastructure spending. The offer, based on an age and tenure formula, provides a choice for eligible employees.
title: What is voluntary retirement programme that Microsoft is offering its 8500-plus employees

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: In the past few years, since embracing the demands of captaincy, Iyer has not only shown how able a leader he can be, but also as a batter who has dominated seasons while balancing the dual roles of anchor and aggressor.
title: How Shreyas’s form fueling his rise in India’s T20I leadership scheme

author: TNN
description: Five police officers in Diamond Harbour have been suspended by the Election Commission for alleged misconduct and failing to remain neutral during the Bengal assembly elections. The commission has also warned the Superintendent of Police for not ensuring discipline among her team.
title: EC suspends five cops for alleged misconduct during Bengal assembly elections

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo is entering the final phase of his career with three clear goals still driving him forward: a first World Cup title in 2026, the pursuit of 1,000 career goals, and the rare chance of playing alongside his son at Al Nassr. Even at 41, he remains central for club and country, shaping both legacy and milestones.
title: Ronaldo’s 3 final career goals before retirement – Messi already ahead

title: Calcutta HC changes EC’s 48-hour ban order on bike movement to 12 hours

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ancient Roman structures, utilizing smooth stone and carefully shaped interiors, exhibit remarkable acoustic properties. Curved walls and vast domes guide sound, creating whispering gallery effects where even quiet voices travel with surprising clarity. This architectural design allowed performers in Roman theaters to be heard by large audiences without amplification.
title: The real wall with ears: Ancient Roman walls can hear you from metres away

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mohammad Kaif praised Virat Kohli for crossing 300 IPL sixes, saying, "Kohli isn't a natural six-hitter but he worked on his game…" highlighting his adaptability. Kohli (81) and Devdutt Padikkal (55) then led RCB’s chase of 206. Kohli said, "His innings was the difference…" as their partnership sealed victory over GT.
title: 'Virat Kohli isn't a natural six-hitter but ... ': Kaif after RCB's win over GT

author: ASHISH CHAUHAN
description: A Gujarat woman's life in Louisiana was shattered by a gunshot during a store negotiation, leaving her critically injured with severe jaw damage. Her husband faces weapon charges as doctors deem her recovery complex, requiring multiple surgeries. A crowdfunding effort is underway to support her extensive medical bills and her dream of a better future.
title: Gujarat woman critical after shooting at US store; husband held for ‘accidental’ firing

author: TNN
description: Three men in a BMW and Toyota Fortuner allegedly assaulted and briefly abducted a toll plaza employee near Bengaluru after refusing to pay the fee. Claiming to be associates of a local MLA, they forced their way through the barrier, punching and kicking one employee and bundling another into their vehicle.
title: Men in BMW, Fortuner refuse to pay toll fee, assault and abduct staffer in north Bengaluru

author: TNN
description: Zen Sadavarte, daughter of a former Bigg Boss contestant, has filed a complaint seeking an FIR against a woman who confronted Maharashtra minister Girish Mahajan during a rally. The woman had protested a traffic jam caused by the event, alleging inconvenience. Zen's complaint cites obstruction of duty and inciting panic.
title: ‘Insult to police’: Cop’s granddaughter seeks FIR against woman who yelled at BJP minister in Mumbai

author: SUMAN CHAKRABORTI
description: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee declared the high phase-one voter turnout a decisive mandate against the BJP, predicting the saffron party would lose significantly. She accused the BJP of atrocities and warned of "democratic revenge" for their actions, urging focus on Manipur's unrest and criticizing their treatment of allies like Nitish Kumar.
title: Forget Bengal, we will dethrone BJP from Delhi: CM Mamata Banerjee after phase-1 turnout

title: With no repolling recommendations, Bengal & Tamil Nadu break 'past pattern', says EC

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar 2' continues its impressive box office run, nearing Rs 1,170 crore worldwide and Rs 1,125 crore in India. Despite facing competition from new releases like Hollywood's 'Michael' and Bollywood's 'Bhoot Bangla', the spy drama added Rs 1.60 crore on its 37th day, showcasing its sustained popularity.
title: ‘Dhurandhar 2’ adds Rs 1.60 cr to tally amid ‘Michael’ and ‘Bhoot Bangla’ buzz

author: ROHIT KHANNA
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the record turnout in Bengal's first phase of polls signals the end of Trinamool's "maha jungle raj," equating people's participation to an endorsement of BJP's "bharosa" (trust) over "bhay" (fear).
title: Bengal polls: Phase-1 turnout is victory of trust over fear, says PM Narendra Modi

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru secured a crucial victory over Gujarat Titans, chasing down 206 with an 18.5-over finish. Virat Kohli's explosive 81, coupled with Devdutt Padikkal's 55, proved decisive after GT faltered in the death overs, failing to capitalize on a strong start. A dropped catch early on proved costly for the Titans.
title: 18 balls, zero boundaries: Three overs that cost Gujarat Titans the match vs RCB

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mumbai were outplayed as Sanju Samson scored an unbeaten 101 off 54 balls, hitting 10 fours and six sixes at a strike rate of 187.04. Samson reached his century on the last ball of the innings with a six as CSK finished on 207/6 in 20 overs.
title: Former MI coach says Hardik Pandya should not be made scapegoat

description: In an IPL 2026 match, Suyash Sharma dismissed Shubman Gill (32) and mocked him by copying his ‘bow down’ celebration, thrilling the Chinnaswamy crowd. Sai Sudharsan smashed a century, helping Gujarat Titans post 205 after a strong opening stand. However, Virat Kohli (81) and Devdutt Padikkal (55) stitched a quick partnership, guiding Royal Challengers Bengaluru to a five-wicket win in 18.5 overs.

description: Stefon Diggs and Cardi B are trending after viral claims suggested a custody battle and lawsuit between them. The rumors spread quickly online, fueled by an alleged quote and unverified posts. However, there is no confirmed evidence or official statement supporting these claims. For now, the situation remains speculation, highlighting how fast misinformation can circulate on social media.

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former New Zealand all-rounder Doug Bracewell has received a two-year ban from cricket after testing positive for cocaine during an English County Championship match last year. The 35-year-old admitted to using the substance and has accepted the sanction. This follows a previous suspension for a similar offense in 2024. His ban is backdated to November 2025.
title: Shocking! New Zealand star cricketer banned for cocaine use

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India cricketer Wasim Jaffer has dismissed comparisons between Pakistan's Babar Azam and Virat Kohli. Jaffer feels Azam has received excessive hype. He suggests this has led to pressure on Azam to perform like Kohli. Jaffer also cited captaincy as a factor in Azam's performance dips. Despite this, Jaffer acknowledges Azam's talent and class as one of Pakistan's top batters.
title: Babar Azam vs Virat Kohli: 'Hadd se zyada hype, 'king' tag ne chadha diya' - Ex-cricketer's blunt take

description: Delhi Police plans a psychological evaluation for a man accused of a brutal rape and murder. The former domestic help displayed unsettling calm during interrogation and even checked into a hotel post-crime. Investigators are building a strong case, including recovered evidence and a positive potency test, as relatives are also being questioned.
title: South Delhi rape-murder accused’s calm demeanour raises questions
